beats.label: Before
beats.text: Oil **15** minutes before sugar: a **smaller** early blood sugar **spike.**
beats.note: Liu, Yabe et al., Diabetes 2026 (Kyoto University)

beats.label: After
beats.text: Oil **after** the sugar? **Not** the same effect.

beats.label: How
beats.text: Gut **hormones** and the vagus nerve **slowed** stomach emptying.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: A **big** dose, in **mice.** Blood sugar evened out by **2** **hours.** No human trial yet.
Follow for food trends, tested before you **try** **them.**
